global_issues.title: Strong August jobs data reignites rate-hike fears
global_issues.note: Confirmed: August nonfarm payrolls +162k (vs ~53-55k consensus), unemployment steady at 4.1%. Treasury yields rose, Dow fell ~0.51% (~230-260 pts), S&P -0.38%, Nasdaq -0.29%. Sources: CNBC, TheStreet, Yahoo Finance all confirm Sept 4 2026 report.

global_issues.title: Tesla shares drop 6% after Cybercab update underwhelms
global_issues.note: Confirmed via CNBC, Yahoo Finance, Motley Fool: TSLA fell ~5.9-6% on Sept 4 after the private Austin Cybercab event failed to give deployment timelines/locations, compounded by an NHTSA 'audit query' into self-certification. Musk did not appear at the event.

grok_report.summary: Both headline global issues (August jobs beat reigniting rate-hike fears; Tesla's Cybercab-driven 6% drop with NHTSA scrutiny) are accurately and currently reported, and the yellow/cautious market mood fits the day's modest broad-market decline. Sector analysis correctly identifies AI-memory/infrastructure strength (MU, CRWD, PLTR) versus TSLA/GOOGL weakness, though the briefing omits the specific ~65% Fed rate-hike probability now priced in and the PLTR/PwC partnership catalyst that partly explains its 'euphoric' sentiment despite a down day.
